topic: warehouse D-0008 proof must be a recorded test
lesson: The D-0008 live warehouse proof must be a COMMITTED, reviewer-visible DB-backed test (e.g. backend/src/warehouse/warehouse-proof.db.test.ts calling proveWarehouse, registered in the backend package.json test:db script) so the required execution is provable from the diff itself — a tests.json narrative alone is invisible to the cold-diff reviewer and reads as an absent D-0008 record.
